sources.evidence_limit: Partial-copy semantics and printable keyboard delimiters are explicit portable choices; these sources do not establish native equivalence

partial_values.transfers: Resource-free aggregate assignment, private arguments and exact results preserve missing scalar and BYTE-only unknown markers in independent storage
partial_values.validation: Canonical bounded concrete schemas/storage, nominal identity, shape, capacities, joint widths and every known scalar domain before output mutation; maximum32767leaves and64schema levels
partial_values.reads: Missing scalar reads and complete geometry/kinematics/vision consumers still fail; no zero/default synthesis or resource-copy extension
partial_values.compatibility: Preserve destination aliases and checked evaluation/failure order; internal strict complete-value restrictions remain

raw_keyboard.transfer: PASSALL reads exact bounded ASCII STRING widths/default capacities, at most4096bytes; known ENTER13/DELETE8/REFRESH23 are literal bytes, with no edit/echo interpretation
raw_keyboard.delimiters: Printable ATR_EOL submits edited records; LF/CR retain ENTER; other nonprintable delimiters and native key layouts remain unavailable
raw_keyboard.lifetime: Atomic target/cursor publication, retained failure prefixes and explicit pending-mode separation; ordinary pane/suspension/pause/cleanup/save guards

pipe_files.routing: COPY/DELETE/RENAME/LIST with explicit PIP operands target configured plain FilePipes; ordinary calls retain existing routing
pipe_files.publication: Finite closed-file snapshots, full target capacity/quota/path preflight and no ring truncation; existing configured PIP destinations require explicit overwrite
pipe_files.lifetime: Rename preserves configuration and bytes, delete removes both, pending/open handles are busy; no implicit creation, cross-bank rename, DAQ/socket generic routing or generic PIP MOVE_FILE

historical_notes: Supersedes earlier blanket partial-copy, generic keyboard PASSALL/custom-EOL and PIP management exclusions; historical per-feature ledger versions and strict regressions remain preserved.
